title: Ezra plan cards
description: Groups of square white plan cards on the cream page, each group under a centred 18px caps label with a hairline: a row of small icons joined by plus signs, a 24px sans title, a body paragraph, a big 36px sans price with a footnote, a terracotta pill, the visit time, a 'what's included' list with terracotta check circles, a small note and an underlined link. Three cards across, two centred narrower; one centred pill after all groups. On phones the cards stack and the details fold behind 'Show details'.
notes: the plan icons are media slots: 48px circle placeholders, `iconSlots` of them, unless `icons` is given
phone disclosure is a native <details>: no JavaScript
